blocks.text: Cloud computing sasti ho sakti hai, lekin is mein paise ka dhyan se intezam zaroori hai. Users jitna istemal karte hain utna dete hain, aur agar nigrani na ho to kharcha jaldi barh jata hai.

items: Cost Management (kharche ka intezam): kharcha qaboo mein rakhne ke liye users apne cloud istemal aur kharche ka baqaidagi se jaiza lein, resources ki taqseem (allocation) behtar karein, aur apni zaroorat ke mutabiq pricing plans se faida uthayein.

blocks.prompt: Cloud ka bill qaboo mein rakhne ke do tareeqe bataiye.
blocks.explanation: 1) Baqaidagi se istemal aur kharcha dekhein aur jo resources istemal nahi ho rahe unhein band karein. 2) Apni asal zaroorat ke mutabiq pricing plan chunein.

items: Pay for what you use: nigrani na ho to kharcha barhta hai.
Jaiza, behtar allocation aur munasib pricing plan.
